skills/vmware-aiops.description: Use for VMware/vSphere/ESXi VM lifecycle: power on/off, clone, snapshot, migrate, OVA/template deployment, guest commands and file transfer, batch operations, plans and clusters. Also handles datastore file browsing and deployment image scanning; alarm acknowledgment and reset (which can clear multiple matching alarms); read-only cluster/VM/host/datastore triage; and a user-started scanning/TTL daemon with optional configured webhooks. Always use for power on, clone, deploy, migrate, guest exec, batch, alarms or VM investigation in VMware. Use vmware-monitor for general read-only inventory/eve

Use vmware-monitor for general read-only inventory/eve
